senses.gloss: m. (סָלַק) removal, taking up; being taken away.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 95a:16">Ib. 95ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 60b:13">Zeb. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת ס׳ מסעות</he> at the time of packing up (the Tabernacle) for journeying.
<cite ref="Yoma 24a:7">Yoma 24ᵃ</cite> <he>עבודת ס׳</he> the function of removing (the ashes &c.).
<cite ref="Niddah 53a:9">Nidd. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>עם ס׳ ידיה</he> at the moment she removed her hands.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>ס׳ דעת</he> the loss of the senses; <he>ס׳ שכינה</he> the departure of the Divine Presence.

Cant. R. to III, 6; VIII, 5 עילויה … סִילּוּקָהּ וכ׳ her (Israel’s) elevation (to her priestly mission) dates from the desert, her removal (from divine grace) dates from the desert; a. fr.—Esp. (ס׳ מן העולם) death.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 15</cite> <he>סִילּוּקָן של בחורים</he> the death of youths.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62">Gen. R. s. 62</cite>, a. e. <he>בשעת סילוקן וכ׳</he> when the righteous die &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 1:1">Pesik. R. s. 1</cite> <he>בשעת סילוקו מן העולם</he> at the time of his death; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סִילּוּקִים</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P01545"><he>עתק</he></cite>, <cite ref="Psalms 31:19">Ps. XXXI, 19</cite>) <he>דברים של ס׳</he> words of removal (‘go away’), i.e. harsh words.
